title: Residue-field criterion for a map of finite locally free modules
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let $v:\mathcal E\to\mathcal F$ be a morphism of finite locally free $\mathcal O_S$-modules (that is, $S$ has an open cover on each member of which $\mathcal E$ and $\mathcal F$ are locally free of some constant finite rank [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module]). For $s\in S$, write $\mathcal E\otimes\kappa(s)$ for the fibre $\mathcal E_s\otimes_{\mathcal O_{S,s}}\kappa(s)$, and similarly for $\mathcal F$. If for every point $s\in S$ the induced map $\mathcal E_s\otimes_{\mathcal O_{S,s}}\kappa(s)\to\mathcal F_s\otimes_{\mathcal O_{S,s}}\kappa(s)$ is an isomorphism, then $v$ is an isomorphism.

proof.text: Refine each constant-rank neighbourhood supplied by hE or hF into an open cover on which that restriction is free of the stated finite rank, using IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.exists_restrict_iso_free. Index the composite open immersions by the sigma type of points and members of the corresponding cover. Every point lies in a member of its own cover. The restriction-composition isomorphism identifies each restricted module with its free model, so isFiniteLocallyFree_of_restrict_iso_free gives finite local freeness of E and F. Apply stalk_isFiniteFree_of_isFiniteLocallyFree to obtain free and finite stalk modules at every point.

For each s, the map O_{S,s} to kappa(s) is a local homomorphism to a field. Apply isIso_of_isIso_extendScalars_of_finite_free to ModuleCat.ofHom (v.stalkLinearMap s), using the two finite free stalks and the given isomorphism of scalar extensions. The concrete isomorphism criterion for ModuleCat gives bijectivity of v.stalkLinearMap s. This uses the already proved finite-free matrix reflection theorem instead of constructing a cokernel and kernel and applying Nakayama twice.
Apply isIso_of_bijective_stalkLinearMap to v and the bijectivity at every s from the preceding step. This proves IsIso v without modifying its hypotheses or conclusion.
